title: Group Product Manager, AI Legal Conversational Agent
jd_excerpt:
Relativity is seeking a Group Product Manager to lead claiR, Relativity's conversational AI experience for lawyers. You will own the product vision, lead the claiR product management team, and stay hands-on as claiR moves toward general availability.

The ideal candidate will have success bringing a generative AI product to market, experience managing PM teams, and strong cross-functional communication with product, design, engineering, and GTM. Travel to customer sites will be required.
